name: agent-ctx
description: Each agent loop's own context fill, measured per request; a one-line CONTEXT_PCT_ALERT rides that agent's next tool result. Subagents: absolute 200k warn / 250k finish / 300k stop (stop line on every result); main: 70/75/80% of its window. Controllers get CHILD_CTX on Agent and SendMessage results and CHILD_CTX_ALERT when a live child passes 250k/300k
